summary: PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Persero) Tbk filed a Form 6-K to notify a change in corporate secretary. The former corporate secretary, Mr. Jati Widagdo, has been replaced by Mr. Edie Kurniawan as Acting Corporate Secretary, effective June 23, 2026. The filing is made pursuant to OJK Regulation No. 35/POJK.04/2014. No financial terms, stake percentages, or other deal metrics are disclosed. The change is internal and does not involve any transaction, offer, or strategic review. This is a routine corporate governance update with no special-situation characteristics beyond the management role change.
